explanation: Whether a complete set of 11 MOLS (equivalently an affine/projective plane) of order 12 exists, the smallest open order of the prime-power conjecture (Wikipedia, Problems in Latin squares). Orthogonal is the usual injectivity of superposition and HasCompleteMOLS n requires n − 1 pairwise orthogonal squares. The statement asserts existence with a question attribute; most expect a negative answer, but as a yes/no question the orientation is acceptable. Faithful.
